summary: Full backend + frontend verification of reseller scope restrictions (iter 21). 17/17 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_reseller_scope.py covering: /api/access/me returns exactly {customers.view, customers.edit, invoices.view}; GET /api/customers scoped to ownerId/billingResellerId; GET /api/customers/{other_fid} -> 404; GET /api/customers/{own} returns reduced payload (customer, invoices, reduced=True, no lines/subscriptions, only non-paid invoices); GET /api/invoices returns only non-paid of own customers; 403 on /dashboard/stats, /lines, /orders, /commissions, /invoices/export.zip, /tickets, /lines/{n}; PDF of PAID invoice -> 403; PDF of own pending -> 200; POST /api/customers still allowed. UI (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080): reseller lands on /app/customers; sidebar shows ONLY nav-clientes + nav-facturas (no panel/solicitudes/callbacks/app-users/lineas/catalogo/contratacion/comisiones/usuarios/revendedores/tarifas/cobros); new-customer-btn visible; row click -> /app/customers/55667788R opens reseller-customer-view with rc-name/rc-email/rc-phone/rc-address + 1 unpaid invoice with rc-invoice-pdf-* and rc-invoice-email-* (PDF request fires to /api/invoices/.../pdf); direct nav to /app/lines, /app/catalog, /app/app-users, /app/orders redirects to /app/customers; /app/invoices title 'Facturas impagadas', no invoice-export-bar, 2 PDF + 2 Email buttons. Admin regression: 27 nav items incl. nav-panel, export bar visible on /app/invoices. Agent regression: sees nav-app-users among 8 nav items.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py reached 7420 lines — strongly recommend splitting into modules (auth, invoices, customers, billing, resellers, etc.) for maintainability.
RESELLER_ALLOWED whitelist is clean, but the 403 handler returns Spanish-only detail; consider i18n consistency with REST error schema.

Reseller invoices query uses `fid if fid in fids else {'$in': fids}` — if a reseller passes an unauthorized fiscalId as ?fiscalId=, it silently falls back to all his fids instead of 403. Low-risk, but a `fid not in fids` -> 403 would be more explicit.
